I couldn't find `PAYMENTS_LIVE` or any gateway code anywhere in this checkout. I searched for the variable name and for fake, mock, gateway and env-var usage. The memory is marked as based on your report, not verified against code. The switch may live in a module or config that isn't in this repo.

If you want, I can help make the fallback loud instead of silent. Options include logging a startup warning, refusing to start in production without the flag, or flagging fake-gateway responses. I'd need to know where the gateway is wired up first.
